summary_md: **Oai Chu ([@oaichu95](https://x.com/oaichu95/status/2115087624033722594))** shares **vvv**, which gives coding agents reusable **Remotion** video templates: build a template once, swap in photos and copy, and render the film locally. MIT licensed, installable as a skill (`npx skills add actionow-ai/vvv`), and works across 25+ agents.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - actionow-ai/vvv: Build a video template once, reuse it across coding agents. Editable Remotion templates and an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Codex and 25+ agents.

relevance: Template-driven programmatic video lets agents produce consistent motion pieces without a video-generation model.
